reaction: The final explanation made the two loops easier to understand, though the picture description alone does not show the direction of flow.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the outlet valves was most worthwhile because the explanation distinguished how both valve sets limit backward flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pulmonary and systemic routes felt a little repetitive: each was the only offered action, and neither result explained the routes' different roles until blood was added.

surprise.text: The final result clarified how the heart's two sides serve different routes and how blood returns after each one.

arbitrary.text: Adding conducting tissue was a required step whose purpose was understandable from its title, but its position in the sequence felt prescribed because it was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how circulation connects to the rest of the body, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
